Printed with puzzle:
Miriam Raphael won the 1979 Annual American Crossword Puzzle Tournament and the 1981 Grossinger's Crossword Weekend Tournament—two of the three crossword contests now held annually in the Northeast. Last fall she won a "puzzle-off" held live on "The Today Show." When Miriam isn't racing herself on puzzles, she teaches English as a second language to foreign-born children. She test-solved this crossword for Games in a speedy 19 minutes 6 seconds.
